newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent rebounds on short-covering in US.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent rebounds on short-covering in US.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures rebounded in late afternoon trade, tracking NYMEX crude futures which were levered higher by short-covering, brokers said.
April Brent was trading 17 cents up at $20.51 a barrel at 1654 GMT, off a session high of $20.62 a barrel.
"The U.S. was very negative at the start and then we saw people buying back in, particularly on (NYMEX crude)," said one dealer.
March gas oil was still under pressure, however, trading $2 down at $175.50 a tonne as NYMEX heating oil remained under the cosh, amid forecasts of mild temperatures in the U.S. Northeast.
